info.title: Hire me Hiring Platform API
info.description: REST API for Hire me, an Arabic (RTL) hiring platform connecting job seekers, companies and platform administrators. Every endpoint accepts and returns JSON (application/json) unless stated otherwise; file uploads use multipart/form-data and file downloads return the stored binary. Authenticated requests must send a Bearer JWT obtained from POST /api/auth/login or POST /api/auth/register in the Authorization header (Authorization: Bearer <token>). Endpoints marked as public require no token. All endpoints are additionally covered by a global rate limit (300 req/min per IP) and stricter limiters on the auth, AI and assessment endpoints, which answer 429 when exceeded.

post.summary: Assess a CV against a target role (public)
post.description: No account required. Accepts a target role plus either an uploaded document (multipart) or pasted CV text (at least 50 characters). A Bearer token, when present, switches the request to the AI rate limit instead of the anonymous assessment limit (10/hour).

get.summary: Download an uploaded document (owner or admin)
get.description: Serves the stored file with its canonical Content-Type and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff. Only the seeker whose CV it is, or an admin, may fetch it; everyone else gets 404 so the endpoint cannot be used to probe for other people's documents.

bearerAuth.description: JWT returned by POST /api/auth/login or POST /api/auth/register, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; valid for 7 days.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated but not allowed (wrong role or not the owner)

NotFound.description: Not found (also returned instead of 403 where revealing existence would leak data)

Conflict.description: Conflict (duplicate email, duplicate application, wrong state)

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limit exceeded; includes `retryAfter` in seconds

details.description: Zod issue list, present on validation failures

retryAfter.description: Seconds until the rate limit resets (429 only)

onboarding.description: Register only: profile seeded and still needs completing

JobUpdateRequest.description: Any subset of JobCreateRequest; all fields optional

CompanyProfilePatchRequest.description: Same fields as CompanyProfileRequest, all optional

parsed.description: CV upload only: LLM parsing produced data
